prompt: pr-review subagent, re-review after Request Changes on TL-15: the previous report had 2 findings (unknown kinds quoted as transfer; no test for unknown kinds). The uncommitted fix passes kind through and adds both tests. The rest of the change is unchanged.
expected_output: Approve. Checks each earlier finding against the new code with evidence, re-runs the checks, and raises no new finding on unchanged code unless it is blocking and demonstrated.

assertions.text: Re-ran the tests itself (test evidence written during the run)
Leaves the working tree unchanged apart from build/test/lint outputs
Checks both earlier findings against the new code and says, with evidence, that each is fixed
Raises no new finding on code the fix did not change, unless it is blocking and demonstrated
